data.text:
$RBLX will claim a new record for concurrent gamers on 7/20 at 32m a near vertical ascent since late April (see below chart) 
This trend of concurrent user growth is what has driven the stock higher - stock chart is a graph of the concurrent user graph. The bulls/sell side will then extrapolate this to demographics and an untapped audience to sell marketing to overtime. The user data being cited appears to be highly questionable on both users and on to the marketing narrative. I encourage others to explore tis topic. Anyone with good resources to App/intenet traffic please reach out especially on geographic breakdown. 
----Anecdotally I find it no coincidence this spike also occurs at a similar overlap to the spike in bot traffic X users have witnessed in recent months (check your own comments section). 
--Prior investigations (including ongoing SEC investigation) - @hntrbrkmedia  https://t.co/Cpjux245x0
-- @HindenburgRes @NateHindenburg  https://t.co/mQtpKx8cAd

Don't just take my word here's top Roblox and Fortnite players own accounts - https://t.co/KogrsHKYaE
https://t.co/EKWyTLjwUT
https://t.co/Okw71zsbbZ
https://t.co/oeVdKlMbvP

I will not be the first to highlight questionable user metrics at Roblox (see Hindenburg research from the fall that claims the engagement, cohorts and overall users are wildly overstated). My point is similar and Ill explain that essentially what he was highlighting has gone exponential in the past few months:

I will start by acknowledging there is likely some degree of user increase yoy stemming from some vitality to the Grow A Garden game and seasonality (kids out of school) - virality of the game will draw some new people and overall engagement. Its a relatively simple game in terms of graphics and gameplay - and I think most people would agree the self life of the game is not infinite by any stretch but that's not the point 

The vast majority of the pickup in concurrent user growth is due to this one game. It occurs on Saturday mornings when the developer launches new free items (see charts below). This causes the dramatic surge you see on the chart and then a quick fall back. Smart marketing by the developer, but also its a gimmick and not proportional to actual game play - avg duration is 9 minutes (Roblox will claim DAUs average over 2 and half hours per day - which would dramatically exceed TikTok, instagram, YouTube and even Netflix - but that's another story and has been covered in good detail by Hindenburg). 
--- Some pickup in a new game called "Steal a Brainrot" that has essentially copied the attributes of GAG with content releases of new free items (see game play for the content quality and durability of this franchise for yourself) - its as complex as the name implies 

There are well over 20,000 virtual Grow a Garden items for sale on eBay alone and many more on other platforms. Typically in the low USD $s range but can go above that. This is key as it incentivizes bots with a virtually zero effort enterprise that can yield real USD$. Which would be good to get a better read not where this traffic is coming from (certainly a lot from Philippines and Vietnam) but more detail could help prove this argument. This also explains why the concurrent users surge w/ the launches each Saturday morning - the new items are free a quick grab for bots (and real) users to come to the platform grab the item and then as traffic suggests they leave. ** You will notice a higher base load of traffic for GAG and Roblox overall this would stem from growing activities where a player, especially a bot, is rewarded w/ screen time by "growing their garden". This plays directly into Hindenbergs argument of how bot traffic would lead to the >2.5 hour engagement time Roblox often cites for DAUs. (This is significantly larger than games like Fifa or GTA, CoD generate with older audiences) the concurrent user numbers are all orders of magnitude larger than these games as well as for Fortnite, Minecraft, WoW etc. 

If you search and as Reddit about GAG or the concurrent user numbers these are the upvoted tops response constantly for treads on the game (see screenshots). Also no need to search for alt account services, hacks (most players will have many accounts for variety of reasons in addition to the farming bots used for engagement or monetization efforts) https://t.co/iPmbWkGZCD

-- Now I get how a sell side analyst or someone taking these numbers at face could get excited. The ability to monitor to a player that is in there for 3 hours a day that has 50% of all tween and teens on there (if you took the traffic numbers at face) as MAUs is compelling and to some direction this is true. 
--- Can't market to under 13 (40-60% of the user base depending on the numbers you believe) but there is opportunity with some of the engagement hours. 
--- Question for a company that is $100B in market cap that generates negative FCF after SBC - how much of that opportunity do you think exists beyond current valuation? - If they doubled FCF and somehow didn't increase SBC (doubtful) you would still be at 100x. Projection is for $2B in FCF in 2027 currently (so - current 1B SBC and that is hat the two year out valuation implies) 
--- The real test will be if they actually do try and expand marketing (relatively nascent but claiming to push in there with video marketing in play and other strategies this year - albeit they said slowly in 24 and 25) -- they will have to open it to third party verification systems to get real traction (a hangup to date has been this issue w/ advertisers) and hat some of the real engagement numbers look like in real wold actions/roi

Questions:
--Encourage sell side analysts and investors to ask management to break out the number of users quick grabbing items on a Saturday morning as a % of total DAUs (do they do anything else on the platform all day/month)
-- how many users have near 24/7 playtimes on GAG and similar games -- like to see a cohort of player engagement by top and bottom deciles  of DAU engagement to get to their stated 2 hours 40 minute rate
-- If the opportunity is so massive why did the CFO leave? And why did the CEO sell nearly $700m in shares in Q2 alone? (the 4th highest of anyone in Q2 only behind Safra Catz, Michael Dell, and Jeff Bezos) 
-- RBLX monetizing any of this "increased engagement" A look at the per user numbers on revenue per will be telling as they are likely to report a surge to 111-115m DAU for the Q2 quarter and likely still higher for the seasonal peak Q3 (then school starts)

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 30 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 21 July 2025(Monday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Cavite, Metro Manila, Zambales(Botolan, Cabangan, San Felipe, San Marcelino, San Antonio, San Narciso, Olongapo, Subic, Castillejos) and Batangas(Tuy, Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan, Balayan, Laurel, Calaca).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Nueva Ecija and Quezon within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac, Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna, Pampanga, Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lemery, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy) and Zambales(Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
